hero.bio: I build modern web applications, robust backend architectures, and intelligent automation systems focused on performance and practical real-world impact.

paragraphs: I am a Computer Science graduate with a passion for software development, full-stack architectures, database design, and cloud-native solutions.
I enjoy taking products from initial concept and system architecture through coding, testing, CI/CD pipeline automation, and production deployment.
My goal is to craft user-centered, scalable, and resilient software while constantly exploring emerging engineering paradigms.
